details:
The main goal of our project is to make NASA's spacecraft sent to the Moon and Mars, along with themissions they have carried out, more understandable, accessible, and interactive for students.

Normally, researching the history of these missions requires exploring different sources, switching between images, and learning various pieces of information separately.

Our goal, however, was to bring all this information together in a single simulation environment.

This way, instead of simply reading information, users can enjoy an interactive experience where they learn through exploration.

With the support of artificial intelligence, a web-based interactive platform has been developed.Informationobtained from NASA's official databases has been enriched with visuals to create thewebsite's content. Thewebsite's file archive was then uploaded to the web, and the interactive platformwas finalized after testingits functionality and user interactions.
